the neural basis for auditory‐motor interactions involves the ventral and posterior aspects of the premotor cortex, and the posterior aspects of superior temporal gyrus.

1) the posterior superior temporal gyrus and the dorsal premotor cortex are engaged in auditory‐motor interactions, 2) the ventral premotor cortex is engaged in auditory‐ motor interactions, and 3) auditory and motor systems interact at the level of auditory‐motor representations in the posterior superior temporal and the premotor cortex.
the auditory cortex is not the only brain region involved in auditory‐motor interactions.
